facts.business: Apollo Micro Systems Limited is a multidisciplinary defence technology company and Tier-I OEM delivering advanced solutions across explosives, design, development, manufacture, integration, and testing for land, air, and sea domains.
key_risks: Revenue recognition involves significant judgements and estimates
High inventory levels (₹79,528.92 lakhs) with risk of obsolescence
Significant related party transactions including unsecured loans and investments in subsidiaries
Provisional goodwill recognition of ₹14,517.66 lakhs from IDL acquisition pending Purchase Price Allocation
facts.related_party_note: The Company entered into several related-party transactions that are significant, given the volume and materiality of transactions during the financial year 2025-26 including providing unsecured loans, sale and leasing of properties and investments in share capital of the subsidiaries.
